killedBy: the screen baseline: role and aria attributes are compared exactly (issue #937) reads an entry with no aria object as one with no attributes, without throwing
why: Drops the default that reads a measurement with no aria object as one with no attributes. A capture omits the object for every element that carries none of the nine, and baselines written before issue #937 have none at all, so the comparator throws and screens:check crashes instead of reporting a verdict. The ordinary no-aria fixtures die too; the compatibility case is named so the reason survives a fixture change.
